title: PO-011 source ref is correct; previous f003 was erroneous
description: The previous review (vb-xi2f.38-ppr-001) claimed PO-011's Verus proof references wrong source file (part_03.rs vs part_05.rs). This is INCORRECT. lower_canonical_collect IS at part_03.rs:159 (confirmed by grep and source read). The Verus proof at verification/verus/collect_lowering.rs correctly targets this function. The digest bug is in digest_step_primitive at part_05.rs:140-161 and compile/mod.rs:243-261 — a DIFFERENT function addressing DIFFERENT semantics. These are orthogonal concerns. CORRECTION: proof-writer must verify pub(super) visibility of lower_canonical_collect allows import under cargo verus --workspace.
evidence: digest_step_primitive at part_05.rs:140-161 and compile/mod.rs:243-261 — separate function, separate bug
impact: Previous f003 is withdrawn. PO-011 source reference is correct. Minor remaining concern: pub(super) visibility may complicate cargo verus --workspace invocation.
remediation: Proof-writer: verify lower_canonical_collect import works for cargo verus --workspace. If not, add #[verifier::external] spec or adjust cargo verus invocation.

title: PO-012b integration test artifact_digest_mismatch does not exist
description: PO-012b (CC-DIGEST-005: Digest mismatch detection) references vb_core_atomic_admission_red.rs and target artifact_digest_mismatch. The file exists (51.5K, 26 tests) but the specific test does not. grep found zero matches for 'artifact_digest_mismatch' in that file. The ArtifactDigestMismatch error type exists in vb_runtime/src/error/mod.rs and vb_runtime/src/admission.rs, but the integration test in vb_storage that computes compute_compiled_digest on raw artifact bytes and verifies fail-closed rejection is absent.
evidence: vb_core_atomic_admission_red.rs has 26 tests (lines 337-1249) but none named artifact_digest_mismatch
ArtifactDigestMismatch exists in vb_runtime/src/error/mod.rs:94 and vb_runtime/src/admission.rs:72,296
impact: PO-012b cannot be executed. Behavior-affecting obligation with missing test = REJECTED lane. Plan cannot proceed to proof-writer until this is resolved.
remediation: Proof-writer must create artifact_digest_mismatch integration test in vb_storage/tests/vb_core_atomic_admission_red.rs that: (1) computes compute_compiled_digest on raw artifact bytes, (2) submits with tampered digest claim, (3) verifies ArtifactDigestMismatch is returned fail-closed. Or update PO-012b to reference correct existing test with corrected artifact/evidence.

title: PO-019 proptest cannot achieve stated evidence for runtime Fjall pagination state
description: PO-019 (H-6: pagination state integrity) claims to verify cursor <= limit and page_size constant via proptest in crates/vb_compile/src/tests/digest_collect_tests.rs. Two defects: (1) The test 'collect_pagination_state_integrity' does not exist anywhere in the workspace (grep returned zero matches). (2) Even if it existed, proptest in vb_compile cannot verify Fjall runtime pagination state invariants. CollectPaginationState is a runtime entity in vb_runtime/src/primitives/collect.rs stored in Fjall. Proptest generates test vectors — it cannot inspect or verify invariants on runtime Fjall storage state. Trusted base T7 (Fjall ACID) is assumed, not proven within this bead.
evidence: vb_compile/tests/digest_collect_tests.rs cannot access Fjall runtime state
trusted-base-plan.md T7: Fjall ACID assumed, not formally verified
impact: PO-019 is fundamentally blocked. Proptest cannot achieve stated evidence for runtime Fjall state. REJECTED lane. Must be either (1) converted to integration-test mode in vb_runtime with behavioral scope limitation, (2) replaced with Verus formal proof, or (3) removed from formal obligations as out-of-scope.
remediation: Change PO-019 mode from property-test to integration-test and relocate to vb_runtime integration test directory. Add explicit scope limitation: behavioral test — does not formally prove runtime invariants. OR remove from formal obligations.
